notes: This is the incomplete-context/missing-dependency case required by docs/legal-risk-register.md. MembershipVault is ExternalRegistry, but ExternalRegistry.sol is a relative import not included in the bundle, so isMember()'s implementation - which gates deposit() - is unknown. SC01 must be NOT_ASSESSED (access control cannot be evaluated without the base contract), not silently NOT_DETECTED. withdraw() itself is correctly ordered (state write before the external call) and is the same self-service pattern as the other cases - not a separate finding. scope.completeness must be 'partial', never 'complete', and categoryCoverage must contain at least one NOT_ASSESSED entry (rule R-05).
